Thread outside diameter 4.8 mm, pilot hole diameter for medium-hard wood 3.5 mm, countersink diameter about 9.6 mm, penetration into the lower layer about 100%.
map.螺丝长度怎么选才牢固？: How do I choose a screw length that holds firmly?
As a rule the screw should pass through the top layer and bite into the lower layer by about 2/3 of its thickness. Face connections use top layer + bottom layer × 0.67, pocket connections use top layer + bottom layer × 0.7, then round up to the 5 mm size step.
map.为什么要预钻孔？孔径多大？: Why pre-drill, and how large should the hole be?
map.预钻可防止木材劈裂、降低拧入扭矩。软木用较小孔径、硬木用较大孔径（本工具按硬度插: Pre-drilling prevents the wood from splitting and reduces driving torque. Use a smaller hole in softwood and a larger one in hardwood (this tool interpolates by hardness: softwood uses the softwood pilot value, medium-hard the average of soft and hard, hardwood the hardwood pilot value).
map.平头螺丝为什么要打沉头孔？: Why do flat-head screws need a countersunk hole?
map.平头（沉头）螺丝需把头部沉入木材表面使其齐平，沉头孔径约为螺纹外径的 2 倍；圆: Flat-head (countersunk) screws must sink their head flush with the wood surface, and the countersink diameter is about twice the thread outside diameter; round heads and trumpet heads stay on the surface and need no countersinking.
